انتحلتن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَحَلْتُنَّ (intaḥaltunna) /in.ta.ħal.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
# اُنْتُحِلْتُنَّ (untuḥiltunna) /un.tu.ħil.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
